def predict_take_on(f: dict, p: dict) -> int:
    is_tight_space = f["distance_m"] < p["tight_space_distance_m"]
    is_frontal_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["frontal_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_fast_closing = f["closing_speed_mps"] > p["high_closing_speed_mps"]
    has_space_beyond = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["open_space_second_dist_m"]
    has_support = f["n_supporting_teammates"] >= p["support_min_count"]
    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_danger_dist_m"]
    is_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["attacking_third_dist_m"]
    is_low_density = f["n_opponents_nearby_10m"] <= 1
    was_previous_pass = bool(f["prev_event_was_pass"])

    is_carrier_faster = f["carrier_speed_mps"] > f["opponent_speed_mps"]

    pattern_speed_advantage = (
        is_tight_space and is_frontal_approach and is_carrier_faster and has_space_beyond
    )

    pattern_space_and_support = (
        has_space_beyond and has_support and is_low_density and not is_pinned_to_sideline
    )

    pattern_attacking_third_opportunity = (
        is_attacking_third and is_frontal_approach and has_space_beyond and not is_pinned_to_sideline
    )

    pattern_defender_retreating = (
        f["closing_speed_mps"] < 0 and has_space_beyond and is_low_density
    )

    pattern_fresh_receive_isolation = (
        was_previous_pass and is_low_density and has_space_beyond and is_frontal_approach
    )

    pattern_desperate_sideline_break = (
        is_pinned_to_sideline and is_tight_space and is_fast_closing and has_support
    )

    take_on = (
        pattern_speed_advantage
        or pattern_space_and_support
        or pattern_attacking_third_opportunity
        or pattern_defender_retreating
        or pattern_fresh_receive_isolation
        or pattern_desperate_sideline_break
    )

    return 1 if take_on else 0

    is_under_pressure = f["distance_m"] < p["pressure_distance_m"]
    has_space_beyond = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["safe_second_dist_m"]

    is_frontal_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["frontal_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_defender_closing_fast = f["closing_speed_mps"] > p["fast_closing_speed_mps"]

    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_danger_m"]

    is_in_attacking_area = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["attacking_third_dist_m"]

    was_previous_pass = bool(f["prev_event_was_pass"])

        favorable_momentum = is_frontal_approach and is_carrier_faster_or_equal and not is_defender_closing_fast
        spatial_advantage = has_space_beyond and not is_pinned_to_sideline

        if favorable_momentum and spatial_advantage:
            take_on = True
        elif favorable_momentum and has_enough_support and is_in_attacking_area:
            take_on = True
        elif spatial_advantage and has_enough_support and not was_previous_pass:
            take_on = True
        else:
            take_on = False
    else:
        take_on = False

    return 1 if take_on else 0

def predict_take_on(f: dict, p: dict) -> int:
    # 状況把握:間合いの状態
    is_tight_pressure = f["distance_m"] < p["pressure_distance_m"]

    # 守備者の勢い・角度による質的評価
    is_frontal_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["frontal_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_closing_in = f["closing_speed_mps"] > 0
    carrier_has_speed_advantage = f["carrier_speed_mps"] >= f["opponent_speed_mps"]

    # 突破後の空間的余裕
    has_space_behind = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["space_behind_distance_m"]
    is_congested = f["n_opponents_nearby_10m"] > p["congestion_max_count"]

    # 後方サポートとリスク許容度
    has_enough_support = f["n_supporting_teammates"] >= p["support_min_count"]

    # ピッチ上の位置的リスク・メリット
    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_risk_distance_m"]
    is_in_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["danger_zone_goal_distance_m"]

    # 直前の文脈
    was_previous_pass = bool(f["prev_event_was_pass"])

    # 第一段階:そもそも仕掛けを検討できる間合い・状況か
    situation_allows_take_on = is_tight_pressure and not is_congested

    if not situation_allows_take_on:
        return 0

    # 第二段階:守備者の質的優位性の判断
    duel_advantage = (
        (is_frontal_approach and carrier_has_speed_advantage)
        or (not is_closing_in and has_space_behind)
    )

    # 第三段階:リスクとリターンの評価
    risk_acceptable = has_enough_support or is_in_attacking_third
    risk_excessive = is_pinned_to_sideline and not has_enough_support

    should_take_on = (
        duel_advantage
        and has_space_behind
        and risk_acceptable
        and not risk_excessive
        and not was_previous_pass
    )

    return 1 if should_take_on else 0

    is_frontal_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["frontal_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_closing_in = f["closing_speed_mps"] > 0
    carrier_has_speed_advantage = f["carrier_speed_mps"] >= f["opponent_speed_mps"]

    # 突破後の空間的余裕
    has_space_behind = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["space_behind_distance_m"]
    is_congested = f["n_opponents_nearby_10m"] > p["congestion_max_count"]

    # 後方サポートとリスク許容度
    has_enough_support = f["n_supporting_teammates"] >= p["support_min_count"]

    # ピッチ上の位置的リスク・メリット
    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_risk_distance_m"]
    is_in_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["danger_zone_goal_distance_m"]

    # 直前の文脈
    was_previous_pass = bool(f["prev_event_was_pass"])

    # 第一段階:そもそも仕掛けを検討できる間合い・状況か
    situation_allows_take_on = is_tight_pressure and not is_congested

    if not situation_allows_take_on:
        return 0

    # 第二段階:守備者の質的優位性の判断
    duel_advantage = (
        (is_frontal_approach and carrier_has_speed_advantage)
        or (not is_closing_in and has_space_behind)
    )

    # 第三段階:リスクとリターンの評価
    risk_acceptable = has_enough_support or is_in_attacking_third
    risk_excessive = is_pinned_to_sideline and not has_enough_support

    should_take_on = (
        duel_advantage
        and has_space_behind
        and risk_acceptable
        and not risk_excessive
        and not was_previous_pass
    )

    return 1 if should_take_on else 0
